actions.direction: Sit briefly on a compact gray chair, let her shoulders droop and stare ahead with a tiny deadpan expression. Blink slowly, straighten, stand up, stow the chair and return to the empty-handed neutral stance. Keep the full figure centered at a fixed scale, with headwear and both shoes visible throughout. Perform compact upper-body gestures; only when this named action explicitly calls for sitting, a foot swing or an in-place gait may the legs move. No camera push/pull, tracking, framing change or travel toward or away from the viewer. All props are miniature, below the chin, then completely stowed; finish empty-handed in the reference stance. Any laptop screen and keyboard face HER; the camera sees only the plain matte gray exterior back lid and hinge. Any visible UI uses abstract marks/icons, no readable text or emitted light.
